subjects.name: Arin
subjects.description: Man with dark curly hair and a beard, a red and navy plaid shirt, dark jeans, brown boots and a canvas satchel on his right shoulder

place.description: A sunlit stone courtyard: a pale plaster wall, a black iron railing on a low stone ledge in front of the wall, olive trees in terracotta pots, a worn stone floor.

shots.description: Arin keeps walking from left to right along the railing in the same side-view tracking shot, framing and light.
shots.screen_direction: Screen left to screen right, as before.
shots.sound: Footsteps on stone, a light breeze in the olive leaves; the sound continues across the cut.

shots.description: Arin keeps walking at the same steady pace, mid-stride as the shot begins. Reverse angle from the wall side: the camera stands against the pale plaster wall behind the iron railing and looks out across the open, sunlit courtyard toward him; the railing runs across the foreground. Camera position: At the wall, behind the iron railing, looking out across the open courtyard.
shots.screen_direction: Seen from the wall side he now moves from screen right to screen left, with the iron railing between him and the camera and the open courtyard behind him.
shots.sound: Footsteps on stone, a light breeze in the olive leaves; the sound continues across the cut.
